_what_this_is: One publisher's answers to the declarations the contract refuses to default. Splice these keys into a manifest.json; they are contract-shaped on purpose. This is a worked example, not a set of defaults -- another publisher's answers are different values, and the contract has no opinion about which are right.
_not_declared_here: scored_population -- the entitlement states that define who gets scored. A separate decision with a separate owner.
optional_inputs -- which optional inputs a given delivery carries, and from when. A property of the delivery, not of the editorial policy.
The email cadence unit (click events versus distinct campaigns clicked). Open, owned by the modelling owner, and it moves with the model version.
